title: JSON Pointer Lookup
description: Resolves an RFC 6901 pointer against a JSON document without mutation. Takes document (any JSON value) and pointer (string); empty pointer selects the root. Also accepts URI fragments beginning with #, percent-decoded once before parsing. Returns valid, decoded pointer, unescaped tokens, found, and value only when found. Missing paths, noncanonical array indices (including leading zeros), and array - return found:false; malformed pointers return valid:false with error and message. Only own object properties are read; arrays expose indices, not length or methods. No whitespace trimming or Unicode normalization. Maximum pointer length is 100000 UTF-16 code units.
